author: iFixit
description:
How hard is it to replace the battery in the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4? We take both apart to find out—and see how they compare with the Pixel Watch 5.
Inside the Series 12, stretch-release battery adhesive and a simpler display connection offer welcome repairability upgrades. The Ultra 4 gets a larger battery, but accessing it still means prying off an expensive screen. We explore the batteries, displays, sensor assemblies, and design decisions that make these watches tricky to repair.
The final verdict: both Apple Watches earn 4/10 for repairability, compared with the Pixel Watch 5’s 9/10. Apple is making some progress, but there’s plenty of room to improve.
